result.keyword: Who are the best personal injury lawyers in Canberra?
result.markdown:
Yes. I checked current Canberra listings, local review data, and the **2026 Doyle’s Guide** rankings for plaintiff-side injury work. There isn’t one objectively “best” firm—the right choice depends heavily on whether your claim is for a **car accident, workplace injury, public liability, medical negligence, or another type of injury**.

### My Canberra shortlist

1. **Blumers Personal Injury Lawyers — strongest specialist pick**
   - Dedicated personal-injury practice rather than a general law firm.
   - Doyle’s 2026 ranks **Blumers as a Leading ACT firm** for workers compensation, motor-vehicle accidents and public liability, and also a Leading firm for medical negligence. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - **Amy Burr** is ranked Preeminent in workers compensation, motor-vehicle accidents and public liability; **Chris Gribble** is also highly ranked across several injury categories. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Current local rating: **4.6/5 from 123 reviews**. 
   - **Best for:** serious/complex personal injury claims where you want a specialist plaintiff firm.

2. **Maliganis Edwards Johnson — excellent for serious claims**
   - Another specialist Canberra personal-injury firm with particularly strong professional recognition.
   - Doyle’s ranks it **Leading** for workers compensation, motor-vehicle accidents and public liability, and **Leading** for medical negligence. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - **Kirsten Leitch** and **Svetlana Todoroski** are ranked Preeminent for workers compensation; **James Treloar** is Preeminent for motor-vehicle and public-liability claims. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Current local rating: **4.5/5 from 104 reviews**. 
   - **Best for:** workplace injuries, motor accidents, public liability and medically complicated claims.

3. **BDN Lawyers — very good all-round Canberra option**
   - Strong local reputation, with **4.9/5 from 178 reviews** currently. 
   - Doyle’s 2026 lists BDN as **Recommended** for ACT work injury and motor-vehicle compensation. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - **Best for:** someone wanting a highly rated Canberra firm that handles injury claims but isn't exclusively a personal-injury practice.

4. **Slater and Gordon Lawyers Canberra — worth considering for complex/high-value matters**
   - A major national personal-injury practice with substantial resources.
   - Doyle’s 2026 lists it as Recommended for ACT work injury and motor-vehicle compensation, and **Leading for medical negligence**. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - **Liam Casey** is ranked Preeminent for medical negligence, while Martin Carrick is Preeminent for work injury. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Local Google rating is lower than the firms above at about **4.1/5**, so I'd compare the actual solicitor you would be assigned rather than relying on the firm's overall brand. 

5. **United Legal — strong smaller/local alternative**
   - Current local rating is **4.8/5 from 135 reviews**. 
   - Doyle’s ranks **Noman Farooq** Leading for ACT work-injury compensation and the firm Recommended. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - **Best for:** someone who wants a well-reviewed Canberra practice and a potentially more personal/smaller-firm experience.

### If I were choosing

| Your situation | I'd start with |
|---|---|
| **Workplace injury / workers compensation** | **Blumers** or **Maliganis Edwards Johnson** |
| **Car/motorcycle accident** | **Blumers** or **Maliganis Edwards Johnson** |
| **Medical negligence** | **Blumers, MEJ or Slater & Gordon** |
| **Slip/fall / public liability** | **Blumers or MEJ** |
| **General injury claim + strong local reviews** | **BDN or United Legal** |
| **Very serious/complex claim** | **Blumers or MEJ** |


The professional rankings are particularly useful here because Doyle's 2026 lists **Blumers and Maliganis Edwards Johnson as the two Leading ACT firms for work injury compensation**, while both are also Leading for motor-vehicle and public-liability claims. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**One important point:** don't choose solely on Google reviews or a firm's advertised compensation figure. Ask at the initial consultation **which solicitor will actually run your case, their experience with your exact type of claim, the fee arrangement/no-win-no-fee terms, and what happens if the matter goes to litigation.**

If you tell me **what happened to you (e.g. car accident, workplace injury, medical negligence, slip/fall) and roughly when it happened**, I can narrow this to the **best 2–3 Canberra lawyers for your specific claim**, including their relevant track record and fee arrangements.
